scenarios.name: vbs_launcher
scenarios.description: Real capture: a user runs launcher.vbs from the Desktop; wscript.exe starts a hidden, encoded PowerShell that connects to 10.10.10.5:80 and runs whoami.
scenarios.alert: Alert on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local: process wscript.exe. Review this process and its related activity.
scenarios.label_note: Accepted: the user opens the file (T1204.002); it starts a hidden (T1564.003), encoded (T1027, T1140) PowerShell (T1059.001) that reaches a web server (T1071.001, T1105) and runs whoami (T1033).
